Effective line: You pass incoming ingredient crates and outgoing unlabelled ones. Research appears to be a one-way conversation.
Suggested line: You pass crates of ingredients going in and unlabelled crates coming out, and nothing in between that looks like a meal.

Effective line: Frozen failures line the walls. Some of them are still moving. One of the freezers is humming louder than the rest.
Suggested line: Frozen failures line the walls, and some of them are still moving. One freezer hums louder than the rest, as if something inside wants to be heard.

Effective line: A hot meal, an honest one. The only unmodified food in the building. Restore HP.
Suggested line: A hot, honest meal: the only unmodified food in the building. Restore HP.

Effective line: The unfinished war machine looms. It is enormous, held together by gravy and willpower.
Suggested line: The unfinished war machine looms over you, enormous, and held together by gravy and willpower.

Effective line: The cook behind the counter whispers: "The Grand Chef stopped tasting her own soup ten years ago. Nobody noticed. Everybody noticed. Nobody said."
Suggested line: The cook behind the counter leans in and whispers: "The Grand Chef stopped tasting her own soup ten years ago. Every one of us noticed, and not one of us said a word."

Effective line: Inspection! ATTEN-TION! Who put a dent in my souffle cannon? Battle stations! This is not a drill, it is a souffle!
Suggested line: ATTEN-TION! Inspection! Who put a dent in my souffle cannon? Battle stations, all of you! This is not a drill, it is a souffle, and it will rise on schedule!

Effective line: And what is THIS? A civilian. In my bay. Unsupervised. With flavour on his breath.
Suggested line: And what is THIS? A civilian, unsupervised, in my bay, with flavour on his breath. Disgraceful.

Effective line: Colonel Cornelius Crumb, Director of Culinary Defense. Taste is a weakness, son. Paste is a strategy.
Suggested line: Colonel Cornelius Crumb, Director of Culinary Defense, and you will stand up straight when you hear it. Taste is a weakness, son. Paste is a strategy.

Effective line: Whisk formation! Field-test the prototype on the intruder. I have a ration meeting.
Suggested line: Whisk formation! Field-test the prototype on the intruder while I attend a ration meeting. I want a full report, and I want it bland.

Effective line: He salutes the machine. The machine salutes back with a ladle. The Colonel marches out before it has finished preheating.
Suggested line: He salutes the machine, the machine salutes back with a ladle, and the Colonel marches out before it has finished preheating.

Effective line: It is delicious. It is probably cursed. You feel strong and slightly sticky, and your units will not stop smelling of gravy.
Suggested line: It is delicious and almost certainly cursed. You feel strong and slightly sticky, and your units will not stop smelling of gravy.

Effective line: Some of the pantry is still clean. The jars are labelled DO NOT OPEN, WE MEAN IT. You do not open them. You sell them.
Suggested line: A few shelves are still clean, stacked with jars labelled DO NOT OPEN, WE MEAN IT. You respect their wishes and sell them unopened.

Effective line: Blueprints, recipe cards and signed memos fill the cabinets. Every note signed by the Grand Chef is in perfect copperplate, without one gravy stain. Real chefs' notes are mostly gravy stain.
Suggested line: Blueprints, recipe cards and signed memos fill the cabinets. Every note signed by the Grand Chef is in perfect copperplate without a single gravy stain, and a real chef's notes are mostly gravy stain.

Effective line: The chef who wrote these has never held a ladle. The impostor is exposed, and so is how little they have been cooking.
Suggested line: Laid beside the old recipe cards, it is plain: whoever signed these memos has never held a ladle. The person giving orders in this kitchen is not the cook who used to.

Effective line: Evidence, and a buyer for it. The buyer asks no questions, which is the best kind of buyer.
Suggested line: Blueprints like these are evidence, and evidence always has a buyer. The one you find asks no questions, which is the best kind.

Effective line: Load the smoothie! Purée setting! FIRE!
Suggested line: Load the smoothie, set it to puree, and FIRE!

Effective line: The Grand Chef turns from the stove. She smiles the smile from every portrait in the Pantry. She has worn it for ten years without a crease.
Suggested line: The Grand Chef turns from the stove wearing the smile from every portrait in the Pantry, and in ten years it has never once creased.

Effective line: "Ah. A taste tester. Welcome to the future of dining. The future is efficient. The future does not need to be tasted."
Suggested line: "Ah, a taste tester. Welcome to the future of dining, which is efficient, and which does not need to be tasted."

Effective line: Welcome to the Test Kitchen. Everything here is delicious. I have been told.
Suggested line: Welcome to the Test Kitchen. Everything here is delicious, or so I have been told.

Effective line: Delicious. Delicious. I have been told that is the word. ...Why will it not stay on?
Suggested line: Delicious... delicious. I was told that is the word. ...Why will this face not stay on?

Effective line: You never taste your own soup, do you? ...Neither do I. I cannot.
Suggested line: They always asked whether I tasted the soup. ...I never did. I never could.

Effective line: The Grand Chef's private kitchen. Her apron is spotless. Her chin is a little off.
Suggested line: The Grand Chef's private kitchen. Her apron is spotless, and something about her chin is a little off.

Effective line: A sous-chef is hiding behind the sacks of flour. "She does not taste the soup," he whispers. "She never tastes the soup.
Suggested line: A sous-chef is crouched behind the sacks of flour, shaking. "She doesn't taste the soup," he whispers. "Not once, not in ten years.

Effective line: He eats like a man who has not eaten in a week. "Thank you," he says. "Be careful.
Suggested line: He eats like a man who hasn't had a proper meal in a week, and when he's finished he grips your hand. "Thank you. Please be careful.

Effective line: The real Chef is down there somewhere. I know she is." You feel better for it.
Suggested line: The real Chef is down there somewhere. I know she is." You leave feeling better for having fed him.

Effective line: They never looked at their Chef. They looked at the food.
Suggested line: They never looked at their Chef, only at the food.

Effective line: "Delicious." That is the word I was given for it. I say it often. I do not know what it means.
Suggested line: "Delicious" is the word I was given for it. I say it often, and I have never known what it means.

Effective line: I have no name or face of my own. I cannot even taste what I make.
Suggested line: I have no face of my own and no name, and I cannot even taste what I make. I do not know what is left of me.

Effective line: How will they know it's you? After ten years?
Suggested line: After ten years, how will they know it's really you?

Effective line: Not with a speech. Not with papers. With dinner.
Suggested line: Not with a speech, and not with papers. With dinner.

Effective line: Come here, you. No face, no name. What you are called does not matter. What you do is what matters.
Suggested line: Come here, you. No face and no name, and I don't care a crumb about either. What you're called doesn't matter half as much as what you do.

Effective line: You wore my face for ten years and never once learned to taste. Today you start. Let me give you something to start with.
Suggested line: You wore my face for ten years and never once learned to taste. Today you start, and I'll give you something to start with.

Effective line: So take my old name. Escoffina. I was always prouder of the work than of the title.
Suggested line: Take my old name, then: Escoffina. I was always prouder of the work than of the title, and the name could do with someone starting fresh.

Effective line: ...Escoffina. I will try to cook honestly. I will try to be someone worth the name.
Suggested line: ...Escoffina. I will try to cook honestly, and to become someone worth the name.

Effective line: Leaving the Endless Buffet ends this visit. Town heals you fully. The golems are back to guarding plates, not people. The buffet is still endless.
Suggested line: Leaving the Endless Buffet ends this visit. Town heals you fully. The golems guard plates again instead of people, and the buffet is as endless as ever.

Effective line: Nobody leaves hungry. Innovation Season is over. Dinner is back.
Suggested line: Nobody leaves hungry. Innovation Season is over, and dinner is back.

Effective line: The taste testers are free. They like food again. Please give them seconds.
Suggested line: Our taste testers are free and enjoying food again. Please give them seconds.

Effective line: To {town}, through the great pantry door. Wipe your feet; we just mopped. Free samples by the door. Take two. Nobody is checking.
Suggested line: To {town}, through the great pantry door. Wipe your feet, as we have just mopped, and take two free samples on your way out. Nobody is checking.

Effective line: The repurposed cannon now fires bread at pigeons. This is what we meant by a feeding programme.
Suggested line: The old cannon has been refitted to fire bread rolls for the pigeons, who have never been happier.

Effective line: The real Chef is back in her own kitchen, tasting her own soup. We all cried. Say it with me: Yes, Chef. Louder. YES, CHEF! ...Oh, that felt good. We mean it this time.
Suggested line: The real Chef is back in her own kitchen, tasting her own soup, and we all cried into our aprons. Yes, Chef. YES, CHEF! ...Sorry. I whispered it for ten years, and it feels so good to mean it.

Effective line: The Special Sauce is down the drain and the golems guard plates again. Yes, Chef - finally an order I can stomach!
Suggested line: The Special Sauce is down the drain and the golems guard plates again. Yes, Chef. I can say it out loud now. I keep saying it to the walls, just to hear it.

Effective line: Tarragon! Sous-Chef! Fetcher of things! I caught up with lunch!
Suggested line: Tarragon, Sous-Chef and fetcher of things! Sorry, I'm out of breath. I finally caught up with lunch.

Effective line: Ingredients are coming back from the Test Kitchen by the cartload, even pigs! A happy pig this time; I've had enough professional disagreements.
Suggested line: Ingredients are coming back from the Test Kitchen by the cartload, pigs included, and this time the pig is happy about it. I've had quite enough professional disagreements with pigs.

Effective line: People wave when I fetch things now! And nobody asks for cannonballs - I prefer a lighter lunch.
Suggested line: People wave when I fetch things now, and nobody's asked me for a single cannonball. Flour, eggs, a little thyme... sorry, I'm making lists again.

Effective line: Have you eaten? Sit. I am the Grand Chef, and forgive the apron: the impostor kept it cleaner, but I wear it with feeling.
Suggested line: Have you eaten? Sit, sit. I'm the Grand Chef, and forgive the apron: the impostor kept it cleaner, but I wear it with feeling.

Effective line: Ten years in the walk-in freezer, and I never once forgot the taste of honest soup. They put that sauce in every pot and called it innovation.
Suggested line: Ten years in the walk-in freezer, and I never forgot the taste of honest soup. Meanwhile they put that sauce in every pot and called it innovation.

Effective line: Let me cook for you. I promise there is nothing in it but food.
Suggested line: Let me cook for you. I promise there's nothing in it but food.

Effective line: And you, my dear: you do not know your name yet. Good. That is not a flaw, it is a blank page. Go and do something worth signing.
Suggested line: And you, my dear, don't know your name yet. That isn't a flaw, it's a blank page. Go and do something worth signing.

Effective line: Escoffina. Apprentice. Second class.
Suggested line: Escoffina. Apprentice. Second class, which is one class more than I had last month.

Effective line: Third, if you count the dishes. Chef says what I am called does not matter, only what I do. So I am doing a great many dishes.
Suggested line: Chef says what I am called matters less than what I do, so I am doing a great many dishes. It is a start.

Effective line: I made a sauce today. A real one. I tasted it. As me. It had too much salt.
Suggested line: I made a sauce today, a real one, and I tasted it myself. As me. It had far too much salt.

Effective line: I have a face of my own now. I am still deciding what to do with it. I am trying.
Suggested line: I have a face of my own now, and I am still deciding what to do with it. I am trying.

Effective line: The Colonel's gone. His office is empty. He took the paste recipe with him.
Suggested line: The Colonel's gone. He cleared out his office overnight and took the paste recipe with him.

Effective line: It's one word long. The word is 'paste'.
Suggested line: It's one word long, and the word is 'paste'.

Effective line: He left before dessert. He always did. They say he's feeding the whole Capital now, from a factory.
Suggested line: He left before dessert, the way he always did. They say he's feeding the whole Capital now, out of a factory.

Effective line: Grey, from a tap. Somebody ought to teach that man to cook.
Suggested line: Grey food, from a tap. Somebody ought to teach that man to cook.
